title: Model commercialization taxonomy and procurement signal integrator
creator: Priya Nair
description: As enterprise customers evaluate model alternatives, we lack a unified taxonomy that ties commercial terms, license risk, latency/cost benchmarks and feature deltas into procurement-ready signals. This ticket defines a taxonomy for model commercialization attributes (pricing model, license constraints, data-use terms, support SLAs), builds a small signal integrator that scores models across these axes, and wires alerts into the Console procurement dashboard and the vendor-tracking playbook. The goal is to reduce time-to-decision for procurement and enable automated procurement triggers when supply or price thresholds move materially.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical taxonomy document exists in Confluence with definitions and examples for each commercialization attribute
A scoring rubric implemented in a reference Google Sheet and prototype BigQuery table that normalizes price/latency/license risk into a single procurement score
A lightweight signal integrator service emits procurement alerts into the Console alerting channel for scoring thresholds (P0/P1 triggers)
Legal has reviewed taxonomy and flagged license patterns with risk levels mapped to score adjustments
Hand-off doc and runbook for Sourcing/RevOps with links to dashboards and owner list
